name: hotdata-tabular-memory
description: Makes Hotdata the default database when a Claude agent meets data too big for its context: one database per project, definitions every agent shares, results that stay on the server.

database.title: Database
database.description: Pin the project's Hotdata database id. Otherwise the first `tabular-memory load` creates one and every agent in the project finds it.

project.title: Project
project.description: Name the project instead of letting the repository name it.

read_guard.title: Large-file guard
read_guard.description: Refuse to read a large data file into context and point at `tabular-memory load` instead.

guard_threshold_mb.title: Guard threshold (MB)
guard_threshold_mb.description: A .csv/.tsv/.parquet/.json/.jsonl over this size is refused by the guard.

row_cap.title: Row cap
row_cap.description: Rows `tabular-memory query` returns before it stops and suggests `tabular-memory share`.

budget.title: Orientation budget
budget.description: Characters of orientation injected at session start.

workspace.title: Workspace id
workspace.description: Leave empty to use the first workspace of the login.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: SQL alias of a pinned database. Read from the database when empty.
